applicabilityBasis.summary: PAXG represents ownership of one fine troy ounce of physical gold whose value follows the gold market, rather than serving as a fixed-value fiat payment instrument.

references.label: Pax Gold terms: allocated-gold ownership and market-value redemption

genius.notes: PAXG conveys beneficial ownership of allocated physical gold. Its redemption value follows the gold market and is not fixed in a national currency, so GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is not applicable. Current terms identify Paxos Trust Company, N.A. as issuer. OCC national-trust-bank supervision is separate from GENIUS issuer approval.
